title: 백화점 층별 안내: 뭐가 몇 층에 있어요?
objective: By the end, you can read a department store floor guide (층별 안내), including basement floors (지하), and find which floor has what you want to buy.
summary: Learn to read a Korean department store floor guide and find what you need on the right floor.
note: This floor guide is a practice sample. The store name and floor layout are made up.

task.title: Use the floor guide
task.line: Look at the floor guide on page 1. Then find the floor, pick the place, or write the answer in Korean.

items.text: On signs, F means 층; read the number before it.
B means 지하, so B1 is 지하 1층.
A floor with many restaurants, often the top floor.
Here you buy groceries, fruit, and side dishes.
Makeup and skin care; usually on the first floor.
Clothes; the word before it tells you whose clothes.
Shows if the clothes are for men or for women.
items.example: 남성 의류 매장에서 아버지 셔츠를 샀어요.

items.text: Things for kids, such as clothes and toys.
Go here to ask questions or report something lost.
Where you park your car; usually in the basement.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Read floor numbers with Sino-Korean numbers: 1F = 일 층, 2F = 이 층, 7F = 칠 층. B goes below ground: B1 = 지하 일 층, B2 = 지하 이 층.
To ask staff, say the thing + 은/는 몇 층이에요? For example: 화장실은 몇 층이에요? The answer often sounds like this: 4층에 있어요.

exercises: Look at the floor guide. Write the floor you need: ① 아이 장난감을 사고 싶어요. ② 점심을 먹고 싶어요. ③ 립스틱을 사고 싶어요.
Choose the right place: 우유하고 과일을 사요. (식당가 / 식품관 / 주차장)
Write these signs in Korean words: ① B2 ② 7F
Look at the floor guide. Write O (true) or X (false): ① 남성 의류는 3층에 있어요. ② 4층에 화장실이 있어요. ③ 가구는 7층에 있어요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the guide: 지갑을 잃어버렸어요. ____에 가세요.
Answer in Korean with a full sentence. Use the floor guide: A: 실례합니다. 가방은 몇 층에 있어요? B: ____
answers: ① 지하 2층 (지하 이 층) ② 7층 (칠 층)
① X (4층에 있어요) ② O ③ O
